_note: PLACEHOLDER baseline for the v0.1.8 release (Sprint D8 — Plan B activation + Real-Data validation infrastructure). The MEASURED metrics below are from the live D8.1 compare_decoders run on the 3 synthetic catalogs (support_triage 40 + fraud_alert 30 + billing_escalation 30 = 100 cases, 2026-04-26). The REAL-DATA SLOs (D8-RD-*) and the LAT-2 SLO are SKIPPED and will be measured during D8.2 once a partner pilot golden is available. The empirical Plan B (HybridClassifier) DOES improve over swarm-only on all 3 catalogs : aggregate_macro_f1 0.815 → 0.857 (+0.042), with the largest gain on billing_escalation (macro_f1 0.655 → 0.733, +0.078) — the residual H3c ambiguity is partially absorbed by the hybrid policy. The D8.5 AnchorAwareTemplateRegistry is implemented as opt-in (default = Stub for backward compat) and ships with 10 unit tests pinned in `efe-core::genesis::registry::tests`. Note : the `eval_latency::*` measurements for hybrid show ~10ms because the EfeClient LRU cache hits during the 2nd pass of compare_decoders ; the architectural latency (uncached) is comparable to swarm-only. See `target/decoder_comparison/report.md` for the full delta analysis. Important : the hybrid bench-format keys (`eval_accuracy::hybrid_*`) are DISJOINT from swarm-only (`eval_accuracy::top1`, `::min_top1`, `::aggregate_top1`) — invariant pinned by `scripts/tests/test_d8_hybrid_eval.py` (4 tests) + `scripts/tests/test_d8_parser_slo_definitions.py` (5 tests, including 6-permutation order-independence test).
